headline: A creepy AI-made clip of a Rumpelstiltskin-style imp has become a viral meme online.
score_reason: Pool 3 kept: read in full; a viral AI meme with no harm and no official stake, and current.
importance_line: It shows how AI-made video can spread as entertainment even after people learn it is AI-made; the people affected are mainly online viewers, and the account rests on one outlet's report.
summary: NBC News reports that an AI-generated clip of a creepy imp turning straw into gold, first posted in August by a self-described AI artist and filmmaker, has become a viral meme. One early post passed 900,000 views on TikTok in under a week, and many viewers only realised days later that the clip was AI-made.
